x: Young Alan Black, undeterred by the star names around him, ran a very sensible 3rd stage, dropping places only to Sando and O'Gorman, each of whom broke the course record.

At six miles, Eldon had established a substantial lead from Knight and Sando with Maynard 4th. Our lads had shewn considerable improvement in their team placings and were steadily pulling back the opposition with six men now in 87 and eight in 126.
